pattern.description: A cursor drags from the first bullet down-right past the list, and Notion's blue selection highlight snaps on line by line as it passes each bullet.
pattern.why_premium: Real product interaction shown at readable speed: the line-by-line selection cascade previews the AI action that follows and directs the eye down the list without extra callouts.

build_hint.gsap: tl.to('.cursor', {x: dx, y: dy, duration: 0.5, ease: 'power2.inOut'}).set('.bullet .sel', {opacity: 1, stagger: 0.07}, '<0.05') -- selection backgrounds step on (no ease) in list order synced to cursor y.
build_hint.remotion: Cursor position = interpolate(frame, [0, 15], [start, end], {easing: Easing.inOut(Easing.quad)}); each bullet i shows its highlight when cursorY > bulletTop[i] (hard step, no spring).

notes: Cursor has no candidate box, so manual_box used. Highlights are hard steps (UI selection), not tweened.
